author: opt-B3

contract.sync_assumed: caller separates consecutive calls that reuse the temp storage by a block barrier
contract.sync_performed: __syncthreads inside: 1 histogram init, 3 per radix pass (histogram, scan internal, state), 2 in the compaction (scan internal, buffer ready), 1 in the final emission (scan internal)
contract.k_range: [1, N) at run time, k == N unsupported
contract.n_range: N = 256 x IPT, IPT >= 1, N <= 32768 (16-bit index and count fields), measured 1024 to 32768
contract.type_constraints: fp32 and bf16 (fp16 has traits, outside the focus set), int32 indices derived from the blocked position
contract.nan_behavior: positive NaN orders above +inf and is selected first, negative NaN orders below -inf, never produced by focus-set inputs. -0.0 is normalized to +0.0 for ranking (fp32 through one FADD with +0.0, bf16 through a compare and select)
contract.tie_break_support: inherent: positions come from block scans in blocked order, the compacted candidates are in index order and the ties at the k-th key are ranked in index order, so prefer_smaller_index and prefer_larger_index run the same code as not_guaranteed
contract.sorted_output_support: not supported inherently, post-sort of k

correctness_notes: Every cell passed the full oracle battery for both requirements (random x4 seeds, tie_heavy, sorted_asc, sorted_desc, pivot_tie, all_equal, signed_zero, inf_denorm, quantized_random, relu_quantized). Control is B3_baseline in the same lock section (previous variant). One change: the compacted candidates of thread t sit at a stride of cpt + 1 words and only valid slots are loaded.

low_level: Candidate loads with a per-thread stride of cpt words (cpt = N/1024) hit one bank per warp instruction at N 32768 (32-way conflicts on 32 loads, issued by all 256 threads because the baseline clamped the address instead of predicating). The padded stride cpt + 1 makes the banks (t + j) mod 32 distinct, the loads are predicated on slot validity, and the store side computes the padded word as q + q / cpt (shift and add).

Registers unchanged in the latency kernel (39 to 255), the fp32 N 4096 latency spill of 24 bytes disappeared, fp32 N 32768 spills 648 against 688 bytes. Throughput kernel at bf16 N 8192: 64 registers against 127 for the baseline (ptxas allocation changed with the predicated loads), occupancy 4 against 2 blocks per SM, which is the 1.21x there.
Shared memory grows by one word per thread (cand_words = (cpt + 1) x 256 instead of N/4), 10832 to 10320 bytes at N 8192 bf16 stays below every occupancy step.
algorithmic: Latency against the baseline on the compaction cells: N 32768 k 256 1.34x (bf16) and 1.33x (fp32), N 16384 k 64 1.14x and 1.29x, N 8192 k 64 1.05x and 1.10x, N 4096 and below 1.00x (stride 1 to 4 words, few conflicts). Fallback cells (k = N/16, no compaction) 0.97x to 1.01x, unchanged as expected.

Chained to batch 1 the compaction path is at 1.02x (bf16) and 1.07x (fp32) of B1 at the kill cells N 8192 k 64 and at 1.10x (bf16) and 1.32x (fp32) at N 32768 k 256, the bank conflicts were about half of the compaction path's loss at large N and none of it at small N.
negative: bf16 N 4096 k 256 latency 0.971x: a fallback cell whose code did not change, the padded buffer moves the harness's output array by 2 KB in dynamic shared memory, a 3 percent swing of the kind T28 warns about.
surprises: ptxas chose 64 instead of 127 registers for the bf16 N 8192 throughput kernel after a change that only touched the candidate loads, worth 2 blocks per SM.
open_questions: The compaction path still loses to B1 at N 8192 and below after the fix, the remaining overhead is the branch regions around the per-item memory operations (next batch) and the compaction sweep itself.
